svg.title: 1.2.3 options and decision flow
svg.desc: The evaluation flow for 1.2.3. After checking applicability and the exception for a media alternative for text, review whether the original audio conveys all important visual information. If additional description is needed, check audio description and alternatives for time-based media. The criterion is met if one sufficient method is verified across the full scope. If only a defect in one method is confirmed and the status of other methods is unclear, the judgment is deferred. A judgment of not met requires confirmation that no other sufficient method exists.

g.font-family: Noto Sans KR, Noto Sans KR Variable, Apple SD Gothic Neo, sans-serif
g.text: 1.2.3 options and decision flow
Check scope of applicability and original evidence
Is it prerecorded synchronized video?
Check both conditions for the text-alternative exception
No information beyond the text + clearly labeled as a media alternative
Both met → Not applicable
Does original audio convey all key screen information?
If so, additional audio description is not needed
Full correspondence verified → Met
Option 1 · Audio description
Convey key visual information
through sound with original audio
Option 2 · Media alternative
Convey visual and audio information
in text in the same order
One sufficient method verified across full scope → Met
One candidate defective + other methods unverified → Deferred
All methods checked + no sufficient method → Not met
Insufficient original evidence → Deferred, even if candidate is detailed
Distinguish a single candidate's defect from failure of the entire criterion.
Evaluate the audio description requirement of 1.2.5 (AA) separately.
